title: listCatalog
description: Reads every catalog entry, in tool ID order, through `CatalogReader` (TL-LEND-RM01-RD) on each request.

title: getOutcomeMeasures
description: Refuses an unknown time zone and answers with the month's measures read through `OutcomeMeasuresReader` (TL-LEND-RM02-RD), as of the moment it runs. The report TL-LEND-RP01 calls it from the command line; nothing is kept between runs.

title: findLoan
description: Reads the tool's active loan through `ActiveLoansReader` (TL-LEND-RM03-RD) on each request, and raises 404 `loan_not_found` when the tool is not on loan.
